    说明
    BLOCK_EXPLOSION

    Damage caused by being in the area when an entity, such as a Creeper, explodes.

    Damage caused by direct exposure to fire 因直接接触火焰而造成的伤害

    Damage caused by being struck by lightning 被闪电击中而造成的伤害

    Damage caused when attacked by a projectile.

    Damage caused by being put in a block 被卡在方块内时造成的伤害

    Damage caused by committing suicide using the command "/kill" 使用命令“/kill”自杀而造成的伤害
    THORNS
    Damage caused in retaliation to another attack by the Thorns enchantment.
    VOID
    Damage caused by falling into the void 坠入虚空而造成的伤害
    WITHER
    Damage caused by Wither potion effect 由凋零药水效果造成的伤害
